parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter files by status: 'healthy' (has sha256 hash) or 'warning' (missing sha256 hash)

parameters.description: Filter notes holding this file or a copy of it (same SHA-256)

parameters.name: search

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by note status (repeat for OR). `published` means non-fleeting notes; `fleeting` limits to the current user's fleeting notes. Omit this parameter for the default list (accessible notes plus your fleeting notes).
